meta.title: The assigned user can find and open the PR

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions area as User A.
Stay on the Open tab, where available requisitions can be found.

args.goal: search for PR-1 in User A's Open Purchase Requisitions list, open PR-1, and stop on the requisition details screen showing all of its line items

steps.note: Perform the search and open action and verify the resulting screen displays the requisition and its line items.
Assert that the opened requisition screen still identifies PR-1.
